city.prompt: Create ONE original small game menu node icon, square RGBA with actual transparent outside. Reference image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: study the individual little nodes, NOT the gallery layout. Match the flat symbolic silhouettes, few opaque color planes, thin soft light layers, dark near-black irregular circular support, strongly localized side glow, sparse interrupted vertical fine light trails and 2-4 tiny particles. No text, labels, gallery, tiles, border, checkerboard, photograph, 3D bevel, thick brush paint, conventional outlined UI icon, full circumference neon ring or bright fog. Subject centered slightly off axis occupies 48-55% of canvas, dark round backing about 60%, light dies away by 80%; generous fully transparent margin. Prioritize legible simple shape at 48px. Asset description: An asymmetrical broken city gate shaped like two cupped stone hands, one narrow luminous doorway between them. Silvery ivory stone planes, muted champagne-gold doorway light.
